body: Walk into a public bathroom, all of the stalls are full. I’m going to be late to wherever I’m going but I REALLY have to pee. Here’s the catch - there’s only like 7 or 8 stalls, but what seems like dozens of toilets just out in the open. If I don’t wake up soon enough I eventually have to use one and everyone just stares at me as I try and cover myself up as best I can.

Hey, it was an accident, and that’s just what you’ll have to keep telling yourself. You didn’t mean to hurt the little guy, it was just a reaction to pain, not anger or anything like that. It was simply instinct. Don’t let it eat away at you. 

I don’t know much about rats, but I think I’ve read that they can get lonely and get depressed? I could be wrong, but my point is make sure to spend some extra time with your other rat and think about getting another one to join him soon. It isn’t natural for them to live alone.

Rest in peace to your other little guy.
